description.value: Mumbai Masala is a family-owned Indian restaurant located in the Park and Tilford complex in North Vancouver, serving authentic Indian cuisine since 2005. It offers a full dine-in experience with courteous table service alongside online ordering for delivery or pickup, plus catering. The menu spans appetizers, mains, and desserts with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.
